finding.title: No check forces a step on whose headroom is below the pin's on-power; dropping the min() clamp in _apply_pins_to_bounds is unseen
finding.claim: Mutant d128afa0c1ce3d28 at optimizer.py:2418 (`min(min_on_power, high)` -> `min_on_power`) survives the full gate, yet an optimize() of tests/manual_plan.py's winter house with space pinned on at step 36 under a 0.05 kW total cap (power_caps_extra) builds an inverted box (0.1, 0.05) and moves the plan: objective 63.56 -> 81.57 (+18.01), 95 steps changed, largest step delta 3.06 kW; the docstring's own warning (a lower bound above the upper makes the solve diverge). Full gate: RED-AS-NULL, gate_rc=1.
finding.metric_definition: the optimize() objective of the capped pinned solve and the count of inverted boxes (lower > upper) _apply_pins_to_bounds returns for on-pins
finding.phenomenon_property: A forced-on step's lower bound never exceeds its upper bound: _apply_pins_to_bounds clamps the on-power to the step's headroom
